Definition: splendor (as conspicuous); also a gazelle (as beautiful)
BiblicalUsage: tsᵉbîy describes splendor (as conspicuous). It appears 32 times in Scripture, including Deuteronomy 12:15 and Daniel 11:16.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsᵉbîy belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
